name: Volantio
long_description:
Volantio is a leader in travel technology software focused on revenue and capacity optimization for airlines.  

Based in Atlanta, GA, Volantio partners with major airlines globally such as Qantas, Iberia, Alaska Airlines, Volaris, Jetstar Airways, Emirates, Ethiopian Airlines, Scoot-Tigerair, and others. 

The company’s Yana platform enables airlines to generate incremental revenue and reduce operational costs, while putting greater predictability and control back into the hands of their customers.

We are backed by institutional and strategic investors from around the world including Ingleside Investors, JetBlue Technology Ventures, International Airlines Group (IAG), and Qantas Ventures.

launches.title: ✈️ Roame - Google Flights using points & miles
launches.tagline: Maximize the value of your credit card points and miles with the best-in-class award travel search engine
launches.body:
### **TL;DR:**

At [**Roame**](https://roame.travel/), our goal is to help you maximize the value of your credit card points and miles while reducing the work needed by 100x. 

Credit card points and miles have become so widespread that it’s essentially an $100+ billion asset class. Yet, the process to redeem those points for outsized-valued flights is quite convoluted. Everyone wants to redeem an international first class ticket for 70K points, but few know how and the process can take up to 30 hours to fully optimize. Experts know the tricks of redeeming points, but most people, including frequent flyers, do not.

### **⭐️ Team**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=72364&key=user_uploads/1214689/fde7241e-261f-4e2e-8376-0834cd643e38)

Our First Class Japan Airlines flight from Tokyo to San Francisco, booked for just 70K miles each using [**Roame**](https://roame.travel/)!

[**Tim Qin**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/timqin/) **(CEO)** is a points and miles geek. He spent the last 10 years as a successful investor and operator in internet travel, financial services, and ad-tech companies, earning more than a hundred million for clients.

[**Zi Liu**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ziyuanliu/) **(CTO)** is a full-stack software engineer. He was most recently in charge of Airbnb’s encryption services, creating and managing billions of cryptographic requests.

### **❌ Problem**

1. **Data** access is limited and fragmented for points redemptions. What you find on the travel portals are oftentimes not the best deals.
2. **Time-consuming** to find flights and hotels to book using points. Can take up to 30 hours per trip to search across multiple loyalty programs to take advantage of complicated award redemption rules and that’s just for 1 ticket.
3. **Underutilization** of points and miles leading to dissatisfaction and churn. Chase / Amex portals allow customers to book flights using points-to-cents value on a 1:1 to 1:1.5 ratio, whereas the true value of points can only be realized through airline partner transfers where users can find points-to-cents value ratio up to **1:25**!

### **✨ Solution**

We built [Roame](https://roame.travel/) as the best-in-class award flight search engine, supporting 12 airline loyalty programs and delivering results in  seconds. We even one-up Google Flights by allowing you to search from multiple origin and destination airports including entire states, countries, and even continents.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=72364&key=user_uploads/1214689/673c55d7-864f-406b-b298-6dfdee20e42c)

We currently search for points redemption availability across these 12 airline programs and their partners airlines (180+):

 1. AeroMexico Club Premier
 2. Air Canada Aeroplan
 3. Air France / KLM Flying Blue
 4. Alaska Mileage Plan
 5. American Airlines AAdvantage
 6. Avianca Lifemiles
 7. Delta SkyMiles
 8. Emirates Skywards
 9. Iberia Plus
10. Jetblue TrueBlue
11. United Airlines MileagePlus
12. Virgin Atlantic Flying Club

### **🙏 Asks**

* **Sign up** for [**Roame**](https://roame.travel/) and search for **free**! Would love feedback or suggestions on how we can make Roame better serve your points journey.
* Connect us with **credit card issuers** (Chase, American Express, Citi, Capital One, Wells Fargo, etc.), **networks** (Visa, Mastercard, etc.), **personal finance gurus/apps** (CreditKarma, NerdWallet, CreditSesame, etc.), and **travel bloggers/content writers**.

Maximize the value of your points and miles with [Roame](https://roame.travel/) ✈️\
You can follow us on [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/roame.travel/) or [Twitter](https://twitter.com/roametravel). You can also reach us at [founders@roame.travel](mailto:founders@roame.travel).

launches.title: Forerunner - Copilot for aerospace engineers
launches.tagline: Forerunner collaborates with engineers to accelerate development of defense tech, satellites, and rockets.
launches.body:
### **BLUF**

[Forerunner](https://tryforerunner.com) automates repetitive hardware engineering tasks, helping hardware teams speed up design iterations and stay aligned. Our AI-powered Slackbot integrates with software like Confluence and GitHub, enabling engineers to efficiently access the latest data (“What’s the current thrust on our Methalox engine?”), run calculations (“Solve for mass flow rate on the cold gas thruster”), and update files (“Update SRB design thrust with new test data”).

With Forerunner, engineers can focus on what matters: designing and building hardware systems.

<https://youtu.be/0EsKdLXPFAs>

### **The Ask – Refer Us**

We’d like to chat with any engineering leads at aerospace, defense, and hardware companies! 

Email [yash@tryforerunner.com](mailto:yash@tryforerunner.com) if you or your friends are building cool hardware! 

### **Who we are**

We’re [Yash](http://linkedin.com/in/yashkadadi) and [Will](http://linkedin.com/in/william-nida)! We’re lifelong aerospace nerds. We’ve launched liquid biprop rockets and built CubeSats at Stanford, and we have deployed hardware and software at SpaceX (Starship and Starlink), Anduril (Altius), and NASA (ISS operations).

### **Why this matters**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=85132&key=user_uploads/695093/61c93aea-f5e3-4ed2-a5eb-c0b0788ada17)

_An FPV drone carrying a warhead disables Russian armor. Credit: United24_

[The world is on fire](https://www.cnn.com/2024/10/24/europe/ukraine-north-korean-troops-spotted-kursk-intl-latam/index.html), and we desperately need to fly the next generation of autonomous weapons, satellites, launch vehicles, hypersonics, and eVTOL aircraft. 

However, inefficient engineering software is slowing us down. We personally experienced the frustration of digging through hundreds of slides of primary structures analysis, setting up Excel hand-calcs with equations from Roark’s, and missing flight deadlines.

To accelerate the development of critical aerospace and defense hardware, we need to automate slow, tedious workflows for engineers. 

### **How we solve this**

Forerunner automates repetitive tasks in aerospace engineering. Today, Forerunner can:

* Update turbopump design specs in Document A by querying and synthesizing test results from Documents B and C.
* Size the mass budget for a comms satellite using techniques in The New SMAD. Generate compliant test plans based on [Air Force Space Command procedures](https://explorers.larc.nasa.gov/2019APSMEX/MO/pdf_files/SMC-S-016_05SEP2014.pdf).
* Analyze assembly instructions for an arming fuse and generate an inspection plan for QA.
* Track system-level requirements for a loitering munition; when new wingbox subsystem specs are uploaded, Forerunner flags and corrects any inconsistencies with system requirements.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=85132&key=user_uploads/695093/7042fafb-b9b4-449a-9bac-9c11b3bf9309)

launches.title: Skymerse: Autopilot for Flight Operations
launches.tagline: From planning and monitoring in the operations center to real-time support in the cockpit.
launches.body:
I’m Damian, founder of Skymerse (S26). I’m a licensed flight dispatcher and have spent 10 years working across flight operations, aviation data, and software.

We’re building one AI system to automate flight operations - from planning and monitoring in the operations center to real-time support in the cockpit.

Our goal is full automation of the work behind every flight.

<https://youtu.be/czP5N1FJ1ds>

## The problem

Airlines have spent decades digitizing flight operations. The information moved from paper to screens. The work of understanding it did not. A flight exists across many systems. Each system may be good at its own job, but the complete operational picture exists between them.

Pilots and operations teams still have to build that picture themselves. They search, compare, and interpret information to plan, monitor, and adapt every flight from schedule to landing.

When something changes, they do it again. When responsibility moves from the operations center to the crew, much of the context has to be passed on or rebuilt.

Today, people are the integration layer.

## What Skymerse does

Skymerse builds a live operational model of every flight. When an airline’s schedule flows in, it assembles the operational context for each flight and keeps it current as conditions change.

That model is the foundation for automation. Skymerse does not stop at displaying information or sending an alert. It understands what a change means for the flight, updates the operation, and carries the required work forward automatically.

Skymerse plans, monitors, and adapts flights from the operations center to the cockpit. Instead of rebuilding context across tools and handoffs, Skymerse manages each flight as one continuous process, from schedule to landing.

## Why I started Skymerse

Skymerse started with [Notamify.com](http://Notamify.com). I built Notamify because I was amazed by how much information pilots and ops teams have to process before every flight - and how much of that work was still done by hand.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=111421&key=user_uploads/1472269/7e9fe835-e22f-4cb1-92dc-ac0f99a0cce2)

Notamify interprets every single NOTAM into operational impact. It reduces the briefing time from 2 hours to 2 minutes per flight. It now serves airline customers and thousands of pilots and aviation professionals.

As we built it, the larger problem became clear. Making one source easier interpreted is valuable, but people still have to connect it with the rest of the operation. They still have to work out what it means for their flight and what to do next.

Skymerse is that next step: from helping people understand one part of a flight to automating flight operations e2e.

## Automate your flight operations

We are onboarding airlines that want to automate their flight operations. If you lead flight operations, dispatch, or an OCC, we want to show you Skymerse on your flights.

[Book a demo](http://skymerse.com/demo) or email [hello@skymerse.com](mailto:hello@skymerse.com).
